procedures.title: Demonstration: review a person-down alert
steps: Review the triggering image and surrounding clip, including how the person reached the ground.
Check camera continuity, location and current visible posture; record unavailable or uncertain evidence.
Use the site's approved response procedure and authorized human responders for any real incident; this demonstration is not that procedure.

procedures.title: Demonstration: review possible physical violence
steps: Review the full interaction and surrounding context rather than a single frame.
Distinguish the model's report from verified actions; do not infer identity, blame or intent.
Any real response requires the site's approved procedure and a human decision.

procedures.title: Demonstration: review possible fire or smoke
steps: Review persistence and surrounding frames for visible fire or smoke evidence.
Check confusing sources such as dust, steam, exhaust, glare and welding; record uncertainty.
Use approved site fire-response procedures for a real incident; do not rely on this demonstration procedure.

procedures.title: Demonstration: review a traffic alert
steps: Review the configured road region, lane directions and the complete vehicle movement sequence.
Check normal signal queues, parking, turning movements and camera continuity before interpreting the model report.
Any traffic-control or responder action requires the approved local procedure and human authorization.

procedures.title: Demonstration: review crowd occupancy
steps: Check the monitored region, occupancy threshold, dwell time and visible flow.
Consider ordinary gatherings and queues; a people count does not establish suspicious intent.
Use approved capacity and crowd-safety procedures for any real intervention.
